paragraphs: NDI Recognition Systems sells Automatic License Plate Recognition products to law enforcement agencies worldwide. The same products are positioned for homeland security, where the company says they deliver data and recognition technology for defense analysis and prevention. Commercial uses include city parking ordinances, private and public parking garages and gas stations, and NDI also works with HOAs.

The company says it has worked with cities and countries securing borders, with technology built to perform 24/7 in harsh weather. NDI describes what it offers as a turnkey solution for all of a customer's ALPR needs.

A chief in South Carolina credits the ALPR with an arrest of individuals who broke into 25 cars. A crime analyst in Florida says camera data combined with witness statements, surveillance footage and DMV databases helped solve crimes.
